hypothesis: FCLR-H006: funding + price features improve out-of-sample forecasts of next-24h downside realized-semivariance level log(RV_minus+eps) beyond a signed-component HAR baseline (B1), judged on relative test-MSE reduction.
splits: 60/20/20 by unique UTC timestamp; 7-day (168h) purge/embargo at train/val and val/test boundaries; test -> 3 interleaved blocks

models.B1: OLS on log RV1h/RV24h/RV168h + log RV_plus/RV_minus at 24h/168h (7 signed HAR features), train-only scaling
models.C2: B1 + signed funding(24h) + trailing 90d |funding| percentile + mark/index premium + mark/EMA24 distance (11 features)

primary_contrast: C2 vs B1 on paired test-set out-of-sample MSE
secondary: downside level sign accuracy (sign of predicted vs actual downside level)
inference: >=2000 deterministic moving-block bootstrap replicates (block=24 rows, seed=20261126); report MSE, R^2, sign accuracy, 95% CI on relative MSE reduction, per-block, leave-one-symbol-out
decision_rule: PROMOTED iff relative test-MSE reduction >=2% AND bootstrap 95% CI lower bound > 0 AND test data sufficient; else NOT_SUPPORTED; INCONCLUSIVE if test data insufficient
